description: This file contains the implementation of the UserProfileItemImpl class, which implements the UserProfileItem interface. It encapsulates user profile data related to units and selection flags for live data, graph, and dashboard options.

classes.name: UserProfileItemImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing UserProfileItem that stores user profile preferences such as units and selection flags.

methods.name: UserProfileItemImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields for user profile item: units, and selection booleans.

methods.name: isDashSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the dash is selected.

methods.name: isGraphSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the graph is selected.

methods.name: isLiveDataSelected
methods.description: Returns whether live data is selected.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units used in the profile.
